entries.title: Place cells during space flight on the Neurolab mission (Knierim et al. 2000)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Knierim, McNaughton and Poe (2000) on dandiset 001754, version 0.260728.1352, which holds sorted units, task epochs, the original rate and occupancy maps, and spike-time positions of three rats recorded before and during the Neurolab shuttle mission. It compares spatial information in flight with preflight for each rat, tests abnormal selectivity on flight day 4 and the stability of fields across two sessions, and records why the direction, EEG and three-surface claims could not be tested. The claims come from the paper's full text.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Knierim et al. (2000) from dandiset 001754

entries.name: 001828-mantas-2024
entries.title: Anxa1+ dopamine neurons, behaviour and photometry (Mantas, Contestabile, Skara et al. 2024)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Mantas, Contestabile, Skara et al. (bioRxiv 2024) on dandiset 001828, which holds the paper's open field pose, kinematics and VAME motifs (some with fiber photometry), optogenetically evoked dLight release, water drop and forelimb reaching sessions with annotated events, and arrow maze pose. It tests evoked release in dCP against cCP, the photometry around the water drop and during open field movement, the locomotion of the PD models and Anxa1-silenced mice, the maze speed and reaching accuracy. The motif claims are blocked, as the dandiset's VAME labels are not the paper's; their analyses are shown on the dandiset's labels. The histology, RNA-seq, qPCR and nosepoke data of Figures 1 to 3 are not in the dandiset; the MitoPark RNA-seq counts are read from GEO GSE282753.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Mantas et al. (2024) from dandiset 001828

entries.name: 001878-sun-2021
entries.title: CalMS21 mouse social behavior dataset (Sun et al. 2021)
entries.description: Tests the claims of Sun et al. (2021), the paper describing the CalMS21 dataset of resident-intruder pose and behavior annotations, on dandiset 001878, which holds one CalMS21 sequence (Task 1 test sequence mouse071) with its video, and on the full dataset deposited on CaltechDATA. It checks the format, identities and annotations of the dandiset's sequence, links it to the deposit, and tests the dataset's counts and label fractions. The model benchmarks are not run.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Sun et al. (2021) from dandiset 001878 and the CalMS21 deposit

entries.name: 001888-hristova-2025
entries.title: Absence seizures and sleep in Grin2b+/- rats (Hristova, Fasol et al. 2025)
entries.description: Tests the EEG findings of Hristova, Fasol et al. (2025) on dandiset 001888, which holds the 24-h wireless EEG and EMG recordings, sleep scores and SWD events of 14 Grin2b+/- rats, 2 wild type rats and one rat without genotype. It compares SWD number, duration and timing, sleep-wake amounts and bouts, state spectra computed from the raw EEG, the state in which SWDs start, and the correlation of SWD time with sleep measures. The western blots, development measures, visual scoring and pharmacology recordings of the paper are not in the dandiset.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Hristova, Fasol et al. (2025) from dandiset 001888

entries.name: 001933-chen-2026
entries.title: LRRK2-G2019S and dopamine release from Anxa1+ and Calb1+ neurons (Chen, He et al. 2026)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Chen, He et al. (2026). On dandiset 001933, which holds GRAB-DA3m fiber photometry in the dorsal striatum during optogenetic stimulation of Anxa1+ (15 mice) or Calb1+ (12 mice) SNc dopamine neurons in LRRK2-WT and LRRK2-G2019S mice, it compares evoked and spontaneous dopamine release between genotypes, per power and per mouse, and links the dandiset to the paper's published source data. The imaging, proteomics and western blots of Figures 1 to 5 are not in the dandiset; their claims are tested on the data the paper deposited on Zenodo, in PRIDE and in the BioImage Archive, and counted apart.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Chen, He et al. (2026) from dandiset 001933

entries.name: 002013-amjad-2025
entries.title: Microinvasive probes for dopamine, LFP and spikes in monkeys (Amjad et al. 2025)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Amjad, Mahajan, Choi, Shrivastav, Murray, Somich, Coyne and Schwerdt (2025) on dandiset 002013, which holds the three example sessions of the paper. It checks the recording parameters and task structure, the dopamine response to large and small reward cues at site c8dg, beta-band LFP suppression by reward and cue side at c3bs-c3a, beta bursts around the cue, and the isolation of the sorted unit of monkey P, and compares the dandiset with the paper's Zenodo deposit.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Amjad et al. (2025) from dandiset 002013

entries.name: 002014-choi-2025
entries.title: Dopamine, spikes and LFP through an aseptic cranial chamber in a rhesus monkey (Choi et al. 2025)
entries.description: Tests the recording findings of Choi et al. (2025) on dandiset 002014, which holds one session of monkey T recorded through the paper's semi-sealed chamber. It compares dopamine and beta-band LFP power between large and small reward trials, aligns spikes to the value cue, and checks the unit's waveform and interspike intervals. The surgical, culture, drainage and yield results, and monkey J, are not in the dandiset.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Choi et al. (2025) from dandiset 002014

entries.name: crcns-ret-1-lefebvre-2008
entries.title: Retinal ganglion cell responses in Pcdh-gamma mutant retina (Lefebvre et al. 2008)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Lefebvre, Zhang, Meister, Wang and Sanes (2008) on CRCNS data set ret-1, which holds multielectrode recordings of 325 units from 16 mutant and control mouse retinas stimulated with flickering bars and checkerboards. It compares receptive field size, response time course, firing rate and Linear-Nonlinear model threshold and gain between Pcdh-gamma mutant and control retinas (Figure 9D to 9H). The histology of Figures 1 to 8 and the flash, spot and grating experiments of Figure 9A to 9C are not in the data set.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Lefebvre et al. (2008), Figure 9, from CRCNS ret-1

entries.name: dryad-4j0zpc8hz-didion-gency-2024
entries.title: Chronic warming and dry soils in beech and oak (Didion-Gency et al. 2024)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Didion-Gency, Vitasse, Buchmann, Gessler, Gisler, Schaub and Grossiord (2024) on Dryad dataset 4j0zpc8hz, one table of 96 beech and oak trees grown in open-top chambers under warming and soil moisture reduction, in monocultures and mixtures, from 2019 to 2021. It tests the phenology regressions on air temperature, the treatment effects on leaf water potential, carbon relations and growth, and the effects of species mixture. The soil moisture and chamber climate records are not in the dataset.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Didion-Gency et al. (2024) from Dryad dataset 4j0zpc8hz

entries.name: dryad-tdz08kq5d-wang-2024
entries.title: Phage selection and resistance-virulence trade-offs in Ralstonia solanacearum (Wang et al. 2024)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Wang, Wang, Yang, Lu, Fields, Xu, Shen, Wei and Friman (2024) on Dryad dataset tdz08kq5d, one workbook with the data behind each figure of the paper. It covers the selection experiment (bacterial and phage densities, colony types), the phage resistance, growth, twitching, biofilm and virulence of evolved clones, the variant calls of 28 sequenced clones, the phage adsorption assay and the transcriptome tables. The growth curves, per-clone variant calls, genome reads and the pilB and pilM data of Table S6 are not in the dataset.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Wang et al. (2024) from Dryad dataset tdz08kq5d

entries.name: ebrains-q0fg-1x8-nagelhus-2023
entries.title: Object-centered population coding in CA1 (Nagelhus et al. 2023)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Nagelhus, Andersson, Gonzalo Cogno, Moser and Moser (2023) on EBRAINS dataset 10.25493/Q0FG-1X8 (v1), which holds spike times and tracking of CA1 and CA3 cells in rats foraging in an open field with and without an object, from tetrodes and Neuropixels probes. It covers the template matching of object-tuned cells, changes of firing between trials, object traces, the Bayesian decoding of the object's presence as a function of distance, single-cell distance tuning, subsets of cells, and words and counts of population activity.

notebooks.title: Data check; object tuning, firing fields and whole-trial changes of single cells
Within- and between-trial changes of single cells, and object traces
Decoding the object from population activity, with its controls
Distance tuning of single cells and the cell properties that predict it
Decoding with random subsets of cells
Words and counts of population activity

entries.name: figshare-24639285-tarduno-2024
entries.title: Replicate Apollo sample magnetizations (Tarduno, Cottrell and Zhou 2024)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Tarduno, Cottrell and Zhou (2024) on Figshare item 24639285, which holds the thermal paleointensity measurements of 22 Apollo 64455 glass subsamples that failed the selection criteria and the replicate measurements of twelve single silicate crystals. It recomputes the fit statistics of Table 2, the magnetization thresholds of Table 1, the consistency of replicate directions and the alteration checks.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Tarduno, Cottrell and Zhou (2024) from Figshare 24639285

entries.name: figshare-26877211-ocagli-2024
entries.title: The JECFA portal index (Ocagli et al. 2024)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Ocagli et al. (2024) on Figshare item 26877211, version 1, which holds the table scraped from the JECFA portal in May 2024 as an RDS file and a CSV file. It checks the row count and fields, the cleaning to unique pages, the availability of each field (Table 1), the counts by evaluation year and functional class (Table 2), the content of the unknowns, the most frequent FAS codes, and the count of pages with a JECFA name. The manual validation of 700 pages is not deposited.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Ocagli et al. (2024) from Figshare item 26877211
